The '''Bar Neth system'''<ref name="EAOC" /> was a quinary<ref name="Star Tours Bar Neth" /> [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that contained the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bar Neth]].<ref name="Star Tours" /> It was situated in the [[Albarrio sector/Legends|Albarrio sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> within the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="KOTHB">{{Blog|holocron|7|Death Star timeline}}</ref> the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency offered a [[Frontier Vacation Package]] that facilitated transit to the system and a stay on Bar Neth.<ref name="Star Tours" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Bar Neth and thus the Bar Neth system appeared in an advertisement on the [[Tourscan]] kiosk at the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction,<ref name="Star Tours" /> which opened on [[July 12]], [[1989]].<ref name="The Bad Batch Returns">{{ThisWeek|EU-glArwz-U|The Bad Batch Returns, Your Photos of The Child, and More!|sw_url=video/the-bad-batch-returns-your-photos-of-the-child-and-more}}</ref> The system was later identified by name in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-5.<ref name="EAOC" />
